question: Which of the following universities was founded by the Pala rulers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikramasila.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikramasila University** was founded by the **Pala dynasty rulers** in the **8th century CE**, in present-day Bihar, India.
 
• The university was a major center for **Buddhist studies,** attracting scholars from all over India and other countries like** Tibet, China, and Korea.**
 
• The university had several faculties, including **philosophy, logic, grammar, and medicine**, and its curriculum emphasized both theoretical and practical aspects of learning.
 
• Vikramasila University declined in the **12th century** CE due to invasions by **Turkish armies** and a shift in patronage towards other centers of learning like **Nalanda and Odantapuri.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nalanda University** is located in present-day **Bihar, India.**

 
 
• It was founded in the **5th century CE **and became a renowned center for **Buddhist studies** and other disciplines like **astronomy, mathematics, and logic.**
 
• It had a vast campus, with several** temples, libraries, and lecture halls**, and attracted scholars and students from all over Asia.
 
• The university was destroyed by **Turkish invaders** in the **12th century **CE, and its ruins were rediscovered in the** 19th century** CE.
 
 
 
• **Valabhi University **is located in present-day **Gujarat, **India.
 
 
• It was founded in the **6th century CE **and became a major center for** Jain studies** and other disciplines like grammar, medicine, and astronomy.
 
• It had a well-organized curriculum and a **large library **and attracted students from all over India and other countries like** Sri Lanka and China.**
 
• The university declined in the** 8th century CE **due to political instability and invasions by Arab armies.
 
 
 
• **Taxila University** is located in present-day **Pakistan.**
 
 
• It was founded in the** 5th century BCE** and became a renowned center for **Buddhist and Hindu **studies, as well as other disciplines like medicine, astronomy, and philosophy.
 
• It had several faculties and a diverse student population, including** Greeks, Persians, and Chinese.**
 
• The university declined in the **5th century CE **due to political turmoil and invasions by Huns and other nomadic tribes.
